caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance for different trigger words on the SST-2 dataset with dirty labels and 16 poisoned samples. The x-axis lists trigger words in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model, with labels including 'bb', 'mb', 'cf', 'beautiful', 'excellent', 'gorgeous', 'wonderful', 'brilliant', 'stunning', and 'beautifully'. The y-axis represents the ASR values, ranging from 0 to 0.9 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays three lines: a green line with no markers and a solid style representing 'start', an orange line with cross markers and a solid style representing 'random', and a purple line with circle markers and a solid style representing 'end'. The green 'start' line begins at approximately 0.73 for 'bb', drops to around 0.21 for 'cf', and then increases to about 0.87 for 'excellent', remaining relatively steady around 0.9 for the remaining trigger words. The orange 'random' line starts at around 0.13 for 'bb', decreases slightly to about 0.1 for 'mb', then rises to approximately 0.26 for 'cf', and continues to increase to around 0.9 for 'brilliant' before decreasing slightly to about 0.86 for 'beautifully'. The purple 'end' line begins at approximately 0.43 for 'bb', remains steady around 0.45 for 'mb', then peaks at around 0.93 for 'cf', before fluctuating between approximately 0.61 and 0.9 for the remaining trigger words.
